description:
This process begins with monitoring inventory levels in a warehouse or store.
When stock reaches a predefined threshold, an automated alert or manual check signals the need to reorder.
The procurement team then places an order with suppliers, considering factors like cost, delivery time, and supplier reliability.
Once the order is placed, the inventory system updates with expected delivery dates.
Upon receiving the stock, it is inspected for quality, recorded in the system, and placed on shelves or in storage.
The process ends when the inventory levels are updated after the restock is complete.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/inventory-reordering">
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_InventoryReordering">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_InventoryProcess" name="Inventory Reordering Process" processRef="Process_InventoryReordering"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Suppliers" name="Suppliers"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PlaceOrder" name="Order" sourceRef="Task_PlaceOrder" targetRef="Participant_Suppliers"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_DeliverStock" name="Stock delivery" sourceRef="Participant_Suppliers" targetRef="Task_ReceiveStock"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_InventoryReordering" name="Inventory Reordering" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_MonitoringBegins" name="Inventory monitoring begins"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_MonitorInventory" name="Monitor inventory levels in warehouse or store"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ThresholdReached" name="Stock at reorder threshold?" default="Flow_ThresholdNotReached"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SignalMethod" name="Signal need to reorder"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_AutomatedAlert" name="Generate automated alert"/>
    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_ManualCheck" name="Perform manual check"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SignalMerge" name="Reorder need signaled"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_PlaceOrder" name="Procurement team places order with suppliers"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_UpdateExpectedDelivery" name="Update expected delivery dates in inventory system"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReceiveStock" name="Receive stock"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_InspectQuality" name="Inspect stock quality"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RecordStock" name="Record stock in the system"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PlaceStock" name="Place stock on shelves or in storage"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_UpdateInventoryLevels" name="Update inventory levels after restock"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_RestockComplete" name="Restock complete"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StartToMonitor" sourceRef="StartEvent_MonitoringBegins" targetRef="Task_MonitorInventory"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MonitorToThreshold" sourceRef="Task_MonitorInventory" targetRef="Gateway_ThresholdReached"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ThresholdReached" name="Threshold reached" sourceRef="Gateway_ThresholdReached" targetRef="Gateway_SignalMethod">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">stockAtReorderThreshold</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ThresholdNotReached" name="Threshold not reached" sourceRef="Gateway_ThresholdReached" targetRef="Task_MonitorInventory"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SignalAutomated" name="Automated alert" sourceRef="Gateway_SignalMethod" targetRef="Task_AutomatedAlert"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SignalManual" name="Manual check" sourceRef="Gateway_SignalMethod" targetRef="Task_ManualCheck"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AutomatedToMerge" sourceRef="Task_AutomatedAlert" targetRef="Gateway_SignalMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ManualToMerge" sourceRef="Task_ManualCheck" targetRef="Gateway_SignalMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MergeToOrder" sourceRef="Gateway_SignalMerge" targetRef="Task_PlaceOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OrderToExpectedDate" sourceRef="Task_PlaceOrder" targetRef="Task_UpdateExpectedDelivery"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ExpectedDateToReceive" sourceRef="Task_UpdateExpectedDelivery" targetRef="Task_ReceiveStock"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReceiveToInspect" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveStock" targetRef="Task_InspectQuality"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InspectToRecord" sourceRef="Task_InspectQuality" targetRef="Task_RecordStock"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RecordToPlace" sourceRef="Task_RecordStock" targetRef="Task_PlaceStock"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PlaceToUpdateLevels" sourceRef="Task_PlaceStock" targetRef="Task_UpdateInventoryLevels"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_UpdateLevelsToEnd" sourceRef="Task_UpdateInventoryLevels" targetRef="EndEvent_RestockComplete"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
